effects.name: Stim Haze
effects.description: Combat stims hang in the air. Everyone hits harder.

effects.name: Chilled
effects.description: The coolant has got into your joints.

effects.name: Armored
effects.description: Plated over. Takes a quarter less damage.

effects.name: Frenzied
effects.description: Hits much harder, and doesn't care what it costs.

effects.name: Hulking
effects.description: Twice the size it should be.

effects.name: Shrouded
effects.description: Hard to pin down: a cloak, a blur, a trick of the light.

effects.name: Mending
effects.description: Knits itself back together every turn.

effects.name: Rival Crawler
effects.description: Another crawler after the same loot. Experienced, well kitted, and not sharing.

rosters.name: CorpSec Detail
rosters.text: Chimera security got here first and set up a post.

rosters.name: Rogue Machines
rosters.text: The service bots in here stopped taking orders a long time ago.

rosters.name: Lab Staff
rosters.text: A research team kept working in here, and kept their specimens close.

rosters.name: Night Shift
rosters.text: The production line never stopped, and neither did the people running it.

rosters.name: Dig Crew
rosters.text: Geotechs and their machines, still digging, and whatever they dug up.

rosters.name: Scrap Pirates
rosters.text: Pirate salvage bots are stripping this place, and they don't like competition.

rosters.name: Escaped Specimens
rosters.text: Containment failed here. The specimens own the place now.

anomalies.name: Blackout
anomalies.text: Most of the lights are dead. You're harder to spot in the dark, and so is everything waiting in it.

anomalies.name: Gas Leak
anomalies.text: Ruptured lines have flooded several rooms with toxic gas.

anomalies.name: Lockdown
anomalies.text: Security has locked half the doors, tighter than usual. Pick them, bash them, or find another way.

anomalies.name: Infestation
anomalies.text: Something got loose in here and bred. Extra creatures roam the rooms.

anomalies.name: Collapsing Echo
anomalies.text: The echo is coming apart. Get out before it does, or it throws you out the hard way.

anomalies.name: Static Storm
anomalies.text: Discharges arc across the floor around you every few turns.

anomalies.name: Reinforced Garrison
anomalies.text: Security doubled the shift: many of the guards here are veterans.

anomalies.name: Rich Seam
anomalies.text: This echo is full of things worth taking: extra caches, and you find more in everything.

anomalies.name: Reliquary
anomalies.text: The vault here is something special: two grades higher, and its warden knows it.

anomalies.name: Alarm Grid
anomalies.text: The security grid in here still works. Once anything sees you, responders arrive in waves from the far side.

alarm.text: Responders pour in from the far side of the echo.

anomalies.name: Stalker
anomalies.text: Something in here hunts. Give it time and it finds your trail.

hunter.name: Stalker
hunter.text: Something has your scent, and it's coming.

anomalies.name: Coolant Breach
anomalies.text: Burst coolant lines have frozen several rooms solid, and the cold gets into everything.

anomalies.name: Void Bleed
anomalies.text: The echo is thin here. Now and then it tears open right beside you.

pulse.text: The echo tears open beside you.

anomalies.name: Sentry Grid
anomalies.text: Automated turrets were left standing guard, and nobody turned them off.

anomalies.name: Stim Haze
anomalies.text: A cracked stim tank has dosed the air. You hit harder, and so does everything else in here.

anomalies.name: Forgotten Stores
anomalies.text: Supply lockers nobody emptied: meds and consumables scattered around the echo.

anomalies.name: Skeleton Shift
anomalies.text: Most of the shift never came back. Fewer guards, spread thin.

places.name: Derelict Hauler
places.text: A cargo hauler, gutted and drifting, its gangway lit by whatever circuits still hold.

places.name: Mercenary Outpost
places.text: A dug-in company post: a mess hall at its heart, barracks and an armory off it, everybody armed.

places.name: Research Annex
places.text: A sealed research annex: rows of identical labs, holding cells, and something they were studying.

places.name: Ore Rock
places.text: A worked-out asteroid: rough caverns, cramped tunnels, mining rigs left where they stopped.

kinds.name: Derelict
kinds.text: The crew is long gone. Whatever moved in since is still here, and so is everything they left behind.
kinds.arrival: The air is stale and the lights are mostly dead. The airlock you came through leads back.

kinds.name: Server Farm

objective.done: Every uplink is in. Somebody out there just paid for the data.

kinds.text: Data nodes still hum in here. Plant uplinks and hold them; the grid will notice.

kinds.name: Siege

objective.done: The last wave breaks. The beacon's cache unlocks.

kinds.text: A distress beacon still pulses in here. Lighting it brings everything down on you, and pays for it.

kinds.name: Marked Hideout

objective.name: The Marked
objective.done: The Marked is down. Their kit is yours.

kinds.text: Someone dangerous holed up in here with a couple of bodyguards. Their head is worth something.

kinds.name: Grey Market
kinds.text: A vendor bot has set up shop out here, far from Chimera's auditors. It sells what it shouldn't.

kinds.name: Spire

objective.name: Site Director
objective.text: The site director keeps an office on the top layer, and a bodyguard detail to go with it.
objective.done: The director is down. Whatever they were paying people to guard is yours now.

kinds.text: Layer on layer of the same complex, stacked up out of reach. The higher you get, the harder they hold it.
kinds.arrival: The green pad where you arrive leads out from this ground layer; the stairs and the lifts lead up. The stairwells are sealed until you take the shift overseer's override; the lifts are always open, but slow and loud.

kinds.name: Rift
kinds.text: This breach goes down further than it should. Each layer is worse than the last, and its vault better.
kinds.arrival: The way you came in leads back; somewhere in here is a rift to a layer further down.

kinds.name: Ichor Deep
kinds.text: Cerberus's ichor seeps down through here, and what lives in it grows stronger the deeper you go.
kinds.arrival: Any way out leads back to the arena; somewhere in here is a rift one depth further down.

effects.name: Void Burn
effects.description: Something is eating this from the inside.

effects.name: Hollowed
effects.description: There is less of it than there was. Takes more damage.

effects.name: Black Roots
effects.description: Roots with no plant behind them.

effects.name: Spent
effects.description: The power came from somewhere. Deals less damage.

effects.name: Doubt
effects.description: Takes more damage.

effects.name: Gnawing
effects.description: The thing you fed wants more.

effects.name: Unseen
effects.description: Eyes slide off you. What you do stays behind where you did it, and what you strike with a skill of old comes away thinner.

effects.name: Steady Void
effects.description: Your hands stopped shaking. They move before you decide to, and they stopped feeling, too.

effects.name: Bitter Clarity
effects.description: Very clear, and very cold. Nothing has to wait now, and everything has a price.

effects.name: No One Home
effects.description: Nothing here can be hit.

effects.name: Wither Shell
effects.description: Nothing lands. It all goes in, and it comes back out.

effects.name: Marrow Feed
effects.description: Something else's strength.

effects.name: Afterimage
effects.description: Part of you is still standing where it missed, and it swings when you do.

effects.name: Veiled
effects.description: For a moment nobody can quite place you.

effects.name: Void Leech
effects.description: Hits sometimes feed you.

effects.name: Echoing Wound
effects.description: Hits sometimes leave Void Burn.

effects.name: Mirror Flinch
effects.description: What hurts you sometimes gets hurt back, in Void.

effects.name: Blackout Step
effects.description: Every fifth step leaves a thin shield behind it.

effects.name: Second Shadow
effects.description: A dodge leaves an Afterimage: your next attack strikes a second time.

effects.name: Hollow Reserve
effects.description: Falling under 30% health raises a shield, once in a while.

effects.name: Cold Spite
effects.description: A kill takes 2 turns off your cooldowns.

effects.name: Thin Veil
effects.description: Sometimes, for a turn, you're hard to place.

effects.name: Spiteful Core
effects.description: Casting sometimes gives stamina back.

effects.name: Static Between
effects.description: A critical hit stuns.

effects.name: Borrowed Time
effects.description: You deal 10% more damage and take 10% more.

effects.name: Void Marrow
effects.description: Heals 2 health a turn. The light it gives off makes you easier to find.

effects.name: Wrong Hand
effects.description: Sometimes an attack leaves you some other way than you meant it to. Older skills spill instead.

skills.name: Withering Burst
skills.description: The leaves go black. For a turn nothing reaches you, then it all comes back out as Void.

skills.name: Void Catalyst
skills.description: The slime that comes out isn't stable, and doesn't stay.

skills.name: Last Supper
skills.description: It fills you, and then it starts on you.

skills.name: Black Roots
skills.description: Roots with no plant behind them come up through the deck.

skills.name: All Power to Nothing
skills.description: The shield is real. What it runs on was your aim.

skills.name: Wrong Copy
skills.description: It scans nothing and prints something anyway.

skills.name: Geldud's Doubt
skills.description: A far bigger wall, and you no longer believe in it.

skills.name: Void Rampancy
skills.description: Its mind goes, and what replaces it burns.

skills.name: P.A.I.N, Now
skills.description: No fuse, no warning, and you're close enough to feel it.

skills.name: Milton's Black Stapler
skills.description: He did warn everyone. It burns without light and takes the light with it.

skills.name: Slip
skills.description: You stop being here. Being there costs something.

skills.name: Keep Sinking
skills.description: More stamina than the boots ever gave. The water isn't water now.

skills.name: Dead Hands
skills.description: Everyone nearby is looking at your hands, and can't look away.

skills.name: Steady Void
skills.description: Your next two skills are done before anyone sees you start.

skills.name: Hollow Guard
skills.description: The uniform shows up. Nobody is in it who remembers why.

skills.name: Hollow Podling
skills.description: Not adorable. Doesn't stay.

skills.name: Not There
skills.description: You don't hide. You just stop being worth noticing.

skills.name: Present Nothing
skills.description: You show it an empty card. It can't stop reading.

skills.name: Hungry Roar
skills.description: The roar takes back what you needed from everyone in earshot.

skills.name: Overthink
skills.description: Everything comes back sooner, and none of it is kind.

skills.name: Rob the Hollow
skills.description: It finds what the target had left and takes it, and now the target knows.

skills.name: Bitter Dregs
skills.description: The bottom of the cup. For a while nothing you do has to wait, and all of it hurts.

skills.name: Void Eye
skills.description: It looks at the target and finds the part that isn't there.

skills.name: Hollow Throw
skills.description: It goes through everything on the line.

skills.name: Empty Lunchbox
skills.description: There's nothing in it. You feel full. That's the problem.

skills.name: Dead Button
skills.description: Press it and for one turn nobody is home.

skills.name: Orb of Submission
skills.description: It doesn't change the target's mind. It just turns the mind off.

skills.name: Mirror Parasite
skills.description: It settles in the target and feeds you from there.

skills.name: Hollow Clang
skills.description: The pan rings with no sound, and everything near it stops.

skills.name: The Debt
skills.description: It takes from the target and pays you the difference.

skills.name: Void Refusal
skills.description: A shell of nothing, and everything near it pays for it.

bosses.name: Corrupted Mirror
bosses.arrival: Something in here is throwing a light that isn't on any fitting.
bosses.text: It steps down out of the frame in your gear, and everyone with you steps down behind it. Your skills come out of it in the wrong order, all of them running with Void, and one of them was never yours.
bosses.deathText: The Corrupted Mirror comes apart. What it carried stays on the floor.

challenge.title: Corrupted Mirror
challenge.text:
Black glass in a frame of torn plate, split from top to bottom. Your reflection is already looking at you, and it isn't alone. Violet light leaks from every crack and the air around it tastes of Void.

Whatever is in there is built from you: your gear and your people, with more health than you have. Touch the glass and it comes out.
challenge.tracker: A Corrupted Mirror stands in here
challenge.far: The glass is out of reach from here.
